decisions.reason: Retaining horizontal scrolling for the mobile pricing table does not change the homepage buttons or their destinations; the same message's separate approval of the revised buttons is already represented in this Requirement.
The pricing-table decision does not affect hover animations. The source message's separate decision to retain the animations is already represented by same-message Events in this Requirement.
The source decision retains a mobile table scrolling interaction and does not alter package count, square-footage ranges, package prices, or their display semantics.
Retaining horizontal scrolling on the mobile pricing table does not change the requirement to show individual services transparently or permit individual service selection.
The mobile table interaction decision does not change the one-time pricing model or the requirement to hide monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The retained scrolling behavior applies to the mobile pricing table, not the deferred instant quote calculator or any of its pricing calculations.
The pricing-table interaction decision does not alter gallery category tabs or the optional area for other photography.
Retaining horizontal scrolling on the mobile pricing table does not affect the homepage hero image emphasis, overlay color, opacity, or visual effect.
The source message separately discusses providing portfolio photographs, which is already represented in this Requirement; the mobile pricing-table decision does not change gallery image content.
Horizontal scrolling for the mobile pricing table is unrelated to interactive gallery browsing or its reported gallery glitch.
The mobile pricing-table interaction decision does not alter the requirement for representative images for each service.
Retaining the current mobile pricing-table scrolling behavior does not change the site's image-focused presentation requirement.
